headline: South African Treasury Rules Out VAT Removal on Surging Electricity Bills
summary: The National Treasury stated that scrapping value-added tax on power bills is not under consideration, despite a 165% surge in electricity costs over the past decade.
why: Electricity tariffs are a critical cost-of-living driver for households and operating overhead for businesses across South Africa.

impacts.name: Utilities
impacts.why: Maintaining existing tax structures on electricity preserves current fiscal revenues while leaving consumer cost pressures unaddressed.
